name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 55

clue.text: Drink in quiet Yorkshire town
Most envious set deviously following village plot
Mint’s producing an item of maundy money?
Scrap after second-class game
Abnormally large lettuce modified (trimmed) on outside They say one’s cake hole will do just this!
Fish with spoon-bait and reel
Dislike for opening of authorised translation
Fuelled by unit of electricity or gas
Unseat in medieval sport, with loss of face
Roofing material characteristic of Turkey?
Kentish promontory, as introduced in a painting
Restrict King in a rank
Piece of breakfast crockery Edward flourished?
Fuss about grabbing northern article? Exactly
Support is roped in to act in opposition
Letter from Athenian listing three States
Awareness displayed by one in judgement
Dread showing slip below hem of skirt
Author’s upset — a sad man, maybe, after ridicule
Pastoral poems from the East, such as contain ‘feet’, it’s said!
Old boy in bar looking up a VIP
Quadrupeds in salt, frenzied beasts
Soldier suffers cut, one likely to create needy condition
Doctor Who’s suits will be found in museum cabinets
Wet beard’s from burst —
British tree’s comparatively bare
Sort of lamp about right for light
Journalists’ requisition
